name: harness
description: Role plugins for Claude Code — plan, dev, review, ship, AI-agent (CopilotKit/LangGraph), lead, guards — and the harness bundle that installs them all.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Session and project basics every role uses: verify-done evidence gate, project-init bootstrap, compact/compound memory, sync-memory, btw.

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: Shows a skill's checklist when it starts and each checkpoint as it completes (✅ 3/6), then 🏁 when all are done. Never blocks.

plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: Design before code: brainstorming, grill, domain-model, codebase-design, writing-plans → PLAN.md.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Review a diff or PR: review-checklist, review-diff, blast-radius impact analysis, create-pr description.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Build and fix: coordinator lane router, feature, fix-bug red loop, tdd, checkpoint gates.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Land and release: finish-branch, ci-triage, release-checklist, write-migration.

plugins.name: agent
plugins.description: CopilotKit / AG-UI assistants on Mastra, LangChainJS or LangGraph: architecture scaffolded from official reference repos, tools, HITL, graph, frontend, evals, security, turn verification — with their rules.

plugins.name: workplace
plugins.description: Domain pack for internal workplace / HR apps (time off, approvals, balances, room and meal bookings, maintenance requests): domain rules, starter model, kickoff questions and a domain review. Enabled per repo by core's repo-profile hook.

plugins.name: lead
plugins.description: Improve the process: weekly retro, session diagnosis, authoring skills.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Personal guard-rail hooks: branch guard, commit gate, scope gate, blast-radius and session handoff. Opt-in.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Everything: installs all nine role plugins.
